title: 无锚点的忠实性：关于可解释AI忠实性度量结构性错位的立场论文
summary: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出当前可解释AI（XAI）的忠实性度量存在五大缺陷，导致无法严谨量化解释与模型之间的近似程度，并提出四条研究路径以提升其可靠性。
summary_en: This position paper identifies five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics in Explainable AI (XAI), which make rigorous quantification of explanation-model approximation infeasible or costly, and proposes four research avenues to improve their reliability.
